description: Implementation of a Camb.ai MARS text-to-speech (TTS) service class, providing streaming TTS functionality with support for multiple models and languages, using the Camb.ai SDK.

classes.name: CambTTSService
classes.description: A service class for Camb.ai's MARS text-to-speech models, supporting streaming synthesis with language and model options.

methods.name: language_to_camb_language
methods.description: Converts a Pipecat Language enum to a Camb.ai language code string.

methods.name: _get_aligned_audio
methods.description: Splits a byte buffer into aligned 2-byte PCM samples and remaining bytes.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the CambTTSService with API key, model, voice, and optional parameters.

methods.name: can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Indicates whether the service supports metrics generation (returns True).

methods.name: language_to_service_language
methods.description: Converts a Language enum to a Camb.ai language code string.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Prepares the TTS service, setting sample rate based on model if not specified.

methods.name: run_tts
methods.description: Asynchronously generates speech audio frames from input text using Camb.ai SDK, with streaming and error handling.
